epic.title: Foundations
epic.body:
## Goal
Everything the agent loop needs before any feature card: scaffold, data layer, gates, eyes, design system, CI, Linear config.

## User-visible outcome
A green `scripts/check.sh`, a running app at `/` and `/design`, and a Linear team the Picker can drive.

## Entities
none (no product models yet)

## Dependencies
Nothing outside Foundations is picked until Foundations is Done.

## Status
Implemented on branch `chore/agent-kit-foundations` (see `work/BOOTSTRAP_PROGRESS.md`). Each card below needs Deliver verification, then Done.

cards.title: Scaffold: src/ architecture, strict TS, lint, format, boundaries, env
cards.body:
## Outcome
The repo follows the AGENTS.md architecture map and violations fail the gate.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: 0001, 0004. Related paths: src/, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, eslint.config.mjs, src/env.ts.

## Contract
- [ ] C1 import boundaries enforced (cross-feature, ui->server, lib purity) | verify: `npm run boundaries`
- [ ] C2 TypeScript strict with noUncheckedIndexedAccess passes | verify: `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] C3 env is validated and errors name variables without values | verify: `npx vitest run src/env.test.ts`
- [ ] C4 process.env outside src/env.ts is a lint error | verify: `npm run lint`
- [ ] C5 formatting is enforced | verify: `npm run format:check`

## Out of scope
Product features, auth.

## Data model
none

## UI
none

## Dependencies
blocked by: none

## Autonomy
afk, every criterion has a command.

## Size rationale
estimate 2 because it is config plus a folder move.

cards.title: Prisma 7 + local Postgres, db-guard, test DB, seed
cards.body:
## Outcome
A local Postgres, a Prisma 7 schema folder and a guarded migration flow exist; no DB command can hit a remote host.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: 0002, 0003. Related paths: prisma/, prisma.config.ts, docker-compose.yml, scripts/db-guard.sh, scripts/test-db.sh, src/server/.

## Contract
- [ ] C1 schema is valid | verify: `npx prisma validate`
- [ ] C2 db-guard accepts local and designated hosts, refuses others without leaking credentials | verify: `npx vitest run scripts/db-guard.test.ts`
- [ ] C3 test DB can be prepared | verify: `npm run db:up && scripts/test-db.sh`
- [ ] C4 seed runs idempotently | verify: `npx prisma db seed`
- [ ] C5 app reports DB reachability | verify: `e2e/smoke.spec.ts`

## Out of scope
Product models (first `touches:prisma` feature card creates the first migration).

## Data model
change (touches:prisma): none yet, additive

## UI
none

## Dependencies
blocked by: scaffold

## Autonomy
afk, every criterion has a command.

## Size rationale
estimate 2: config, two scripts, one route.

cards.title: Tooling scripts: check.sh, adr-index/governing, linear.ts, deploy-smoke, loop
cards.body:
## Outcome
Agents have deterministic scripts for the gate, ADR lookup, Linear operations, smoke checks and the loop.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: 0004. Related paths: scripts/.

## Contract
- [ ] C1 the `scripts/check.sh` gate runs every step and prints <= 20 lines | verify: `scripts/check.sh | wc -l`
- [ ] C2 ADR index is generated and linted; governing lookup works | verify: `npx tsx scripts/adr-index.ts --check && npx tsx scripts/adr-governing.ts src/server/db.ts`
- [ ] C3 contract hash, DAG and Picker ordering logic is unit tested | verify: `npx vitest run scripts/lib`
- [ ] C4 linear.ts reaches the workspace | verify: `npx tsx scripts/linear.ts whoami`
- [ ] C5 smoke checks pass against a running app | verify: `scripts/deploy-smoke.sh`

## Out of scope
Hosting a preview environment.

## Data model
none

## UI
none

## Dependencies
blocked by: scaffold

## Autonomy
hitl, the kit says to keep tooling cards hitl until the scripts are trusted.

## Size rationale
estimate 3: several scripts, but each is small and tested.

cards.title: Playwright harness, see.ts eyes, visual test config
cards.body:
## Outcome
E2E tests fail on console errors, failed requests and serious axe violations; agents can look at any route per viewport.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: 0003, 0004. Related paths: playwright.config.ts, e2e/, scripts/see.ts, scripts/visual-baselines.sh.

## Contract
- [ ] C1 smoke e2e passes on mobile, tablet, desktop | verify: `npx playwright test e2e/smoke.spec.ts`
- [ ] C2 see.ts writes screenshots + aria snapshots and prints one line per viewport | verify: `npx tsx scripts/see.ts AEG-0 / && ls .eyes/AEG-0`
- [ ] C3 see.ts refuses non-local hosts | verify: `! npx tsx scripts/see.ts AEG-0 / --base https://example.com`

## Out of scope
Feature e2e specs.

## Data model
none

## UI
none

## Dependencies
blocked by: prisma

## Autonomy
afk, every criterion has a command.

## Size rationale
estimate 2.

cards.title: Design tokens, base UI primitives, components.md
cards.body:
## Outcome
A token-only design system with accessible primitives covering empty, loading, error and populated states, visible at /design.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: 0001. Related paths: docs/design/, src/components/ui/, src/app/design/.

## Contract
- [ ] C1 every primitive state renders accessibly with keyboard focus and no overflow | verify: `e2e/design.spec.ts`
- [ ] C2 visual baselines (light, dark x 3 viewports) match in the pinned image | verify: `scripts/visual-baselines.sh --check`
- [ ] C3 inventory documents every primitive | verify: `ls src/components/ui/*.tsx | xargs -n1 basename | sed 's/.tsx//' | xargs -I{} grep -q {}.tsx docs/design/components.md`
- [ ] C4 human approves visual direction | verify: human review of .eyes/ screenshots (hitl)

## Out of scope
Feature screens.

## Data model
none

## UI
screens: /design; states: empty, loading, error, populated; viewports: 375, 768, 1280; theme: light + dark; reference: none

## Dependencies
blocked by: playwright

## Autonomy
hitl, first UI card: human approves visual direction.

## Size rationale
estimate 3: tokens + 7 primitives + showcase.

cards.title: CI pipeline: required checks, migration check, e2e, visual, merge queue
cards.body:
## Outcome
Every PR runs the gate, a migration check on a throwaway Postgres, e2e and visual tests; main is protected.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: 0003, 0004. Related paths: .github/.

## Contract
- [ ] C1 CI is green on the Foundations PR | verify: `gh pr checks`
- [ ] C2 branch protection requires check, migrations, e2e, visual and CODEOWNERS review | verify: `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/main/protection`
- [ ] C3 editing a merged migration fails CI | verify: migrations job step "Merged migrations are immutable"

## Out of scope
Preview deploys (add when a host is chosen; needs an ADR).

## Data model
none

## UI
none

## Dependencies
blocked by: tooling, playwright

## Autonomy
hitl, branch protection is a human setting.

## Size rationale
estimate 2.

cards.title: Linear board config: state mapping, kit labels, GitHub automation off
cards.body:
## Outcome
The Aegis team board works with the kit: Ready = `Todo`, QA = `In Review` + label `qa`, all kit labels exist, and merging a PR never marks an issue Done by itself.

## Context
Epic: Foundations. Governing ADRs: none. Related paths: scripts/linear.ts, agents/PROTOCOL.md (section "Board mapping").

## Contract
- [ ] C1 all kit labels exist in team AEG | verify: `npx tsx scripts/linear.ts bootstrap --dry-run` prints only `ok` lines
- [ ] C2 Picker ordering runs against the real workspace | verify: `npx tsx scripts/linear.ts next`
- [ ] C3 GitHub integration "PR merged -> Done" is disabled | verify: human check in Linear team settings (hitl)

## Out of scope
Creating new workflow states (the kit is adapted to the existing ones).

## Data model
none

## UI
none

## Dependencies
blocked by: tooling

## Autonomy
hitl, workspace settings are human-owned.

## Size rationale
estimate 1.
